title: Probably not a bit like it really. Kind of stuff you read: in the track of the sun.
html_source:
“He imagines walking through a Middle Eastern market. He quickly dismisses his reverie as overly romanticized and recognizes its origins in the illustrated title page of a travel book he owns”.
Patrick Hastings, The Guide to James Joyce’s Ulysses, 2022.

anchor.text: Probably not a bit like it really. Kind of stuff you read: in the track of the sun.
anchor.prefix: yond strings twanged. Night sky, moon, violet, colour of Molly's new garters. Strings. Listen. A girl playing one of those instruments what do you call them: dulcimers. I pass.
